{{Quote|Right to the point. I like that. There's a guy who was hanging out near where I was talking to these, um&hellip;associates. I didn't notice him until my business was already concluded. I want you to take care of him. Will you do it?|Palejo Reshad, speaking of the blackmailer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he overheard and recorded a tape of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Palejo Reshad]] doing business with associates of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], and he used his tape to blackmail the trader. However, Reshad was unwilling to cooperate with the blackmailer and hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. At some point after the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG" />

While the individual was in Bela Vistal, he overheard and recorded [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Palejo Reshad]] doing trading business with associates of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The individual blackmailed Reshad with the tape of the spice trader's conversation. However, Reshad wished to eliminate his blackmailer instead of paying him.<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Reshad ended up meeting a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was willing to help. After Reshad explained his situation, the spacer set out to find the blackmailer in the surrounding mountains of Corellia. However, the blackmailer was not willing to give up the tape, believing it would make him rich, and fought with the spacer. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the subsequent battle. The spacer then returned to Reshad and was awarded with 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're not getting this tape! It's mine! It'll make me rich!|The blackmailer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
The blackmailer believed his tape of Palejo Reshad's conversation would make him rich.<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Not wanting to give up the tape for that reason, he attacked the spacer whom Reshad sent after him, which led to the blackmailer's death.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MercenaryTemplateMale.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of the blackmailer]]
[[File:PilotFemaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions]]
This individual, simply identified as the '''Blackmailer''', was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players performing a [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] for Palejo Reshad had to kill the blackmailer. Because the blackmailer spawned under the generic "[[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]" template, his appearance was randomized under one of seven possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] the blackmailer could appear as included [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] of either gender, and a male [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]]. The quest dialogue identified the blackmailer as male, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. Although the player could choose not to pursue the blackmailer, this article assumes 100 percent game completion.<ref name="SWG" />
